title: Maratón Ciudad de Buenos Aires — World Athletics Label Road Race results, 20 September 2026
claims: World Athletics lists the 2026 men's top ten as Bethwel Kibet 2:08:28, John Hakizimana 2:08:39, Felix Kirwa 2:10:24, Kipkemoi Kiprono 2:10:49, Vincent Kibor Raimoi 2:11:50, Embay Goitom 2:12:28, Ricardo Rojas 2:14:47, David Gomez 2:15:23, Ignacio Erario 2:16:42 and Ignacio Reyes 2:21:46.

World Athletics lists the 2026 women's top nine as Rebecca Chesir 2:23:36, Rodah Tanui 2:24:49, Emmah Ndiwa 2:26:55, Sentayehu Lewetegn 2:29:53, Tamir Agere 2:30:19, Lomi Muleta 2:32:15, Chiara Mainetti 2:38:25, Anahi Castaño 2:44:21 and Mercedes Piredda 2:49:15.
The leading Argentine men were Ignacio Erario in ninth, Ignacio Reyes in tenth and Esteban Angulo in twelfth; Angulo's time was 2:23:01.
The leading Argentine women were Chiara Mainetti in seventh, Anahi Castaño in eighth and Mercedes Piredda in ninth.

World Athletics gives the winning times as 2:08:28 and 2:23:36; an EFE/InfoBaires report gives 2:08:22 and 2:23:31 and lists Piredda at 2:48:11, so the official page and the media report differ by 5–6 seconds and 64 seconds.

verification.note: WA 官方成绩页逐行读取男子前 30、女子前 32；本页只保留男子前 10 与女子前 9。与 EFE/InfoBaires 的秒级差异逐条保留，不取平均。
